test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

Savita had a good look at my presentation and advised me to change the font. She also said she did not think the design matched the content.

options.text: Savita had a look at my presentation and said, “Change the font. I think the design must match the content.”
Savita was looking at my presentation and saying, “You have to change the font. I think the design must match the content.”
Savita had a look at my presentation and said, “Please change the font. I think the design must match the content.”
Savita had a look at my presentation and said, “You should change the font. I don’t think the design matches the content.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **Savita had a look at my presentation and said, “You should change the font. | don’t think the design matches the content.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech and we need to convert it into direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to a direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reported verb 'advised' changes to 'said' in the reporting speech part.
 
• To express advice phrase, "should" is used in direct speech. ("should" express "advice")
 
• The preposition 'to' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The pronoun '**me**' changes to '**you**' in direct speech.
 
• The first person pronoun 'I' changes to the third person pronoun 'she' in direct speech.
 
• The auxiliary verb 'did not' changes to 'don't' in the direct speech.
 
• The past form of the verb 'matched' changes to the present form 'matches' in direct speech.
 
• We use 'also said' in indirect speech when there is more than one clause is given.
 
 

Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *Savita had a look at my presentation and said, “You should change the font. | don’t think the design matches the content.”*
